title: 第15章  季欢有男朋友了第16章  偷偷地滚上床
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
裴西川笑得很坏，声音里也透着几丝痞。
“季欢，你确定，要是他装醉呢？你可能就永远失去他了。”
他们都在互相试探。
季欢在试探，裴西川的心里，她和程永夜哪个更重要？
裴西川也在试探她。
他想知道，对季欢来说，她有没有一点点喜欢他。
季欢圈住他的脖子。
“他肯定醉了，就看你敢不敢当着他的面。”
两个坏人，互相刺激着对方，眼底的那抹暗色却在无限放大。
季欢深目看着面前的这个男人，他兽身是黑蛇，人身非常完美。
有着一张英俊到无可挑剔的脸。
并且他还是裴氏集团总裁，富可敌国。
他哪一项单拎出来，都比程永夜优秀，所以她觉得不亏。
突然她有了主意。
既然今晚要和他上床，那么她可以提个条件。
也不能让他白睡。
程永夜倒在沙发里后，就睡过去了，时不时呓语几声。
季欢淡淡的瞥他一眼，接着她去解裴西川的扣子，手往他的胸膛上摸去。
她大胆又放、荡，很坏，却很勾人。
裴西川目光微深，对于她这样，他完全没有抵抗力。

他目光变得凶狠，邪火被她勾得越来越旺盛，他现在只想狠狠地占她为己有。
裴西川大手掐住她的下巴，他吻她最喜欢这种强势的方法。
就在他要吻上她唇的时候，季欢用一根手指挡住他的唇。
“裴总，我有件事要请你帮忙。”
裴西川此时被勾的已经无法克制了，她却不让他进一步。
他就像被架在火上烤，于是他淡声说。
“好，都答应你！”
他连问题都不听，就直接答应了，此时他更想的是和她做。
季欢看他这么敷衍。
“裴总，我是认真的，不然，我就回去了。”
说罢她就要从他的身上下来，要离开的样子。
裴西川大手掐住她的腰，把她按住，不让她走。
“你说！”
某个男人终于是认真一点了。
content_en:
Pei Xichuan smiled evilly, with a hint of scorn in his voice.
"Ji Huan, are you sure? What if he pretends to be drunk? You might lose him forever."
They were all testing each other.
Ji Huan is testing, in Pei Xichuan's heart, which one is more important, her or Cheng Yongye?
Pei Xichuan was also testing her.
He wanted to know whether Ji Huan liked him at all.
Ji Huan wrapped his arms around his neck.
"He must be drunk. It depends on whether you dare to do it in front of him."
The two villains were stimulating each other, but the darkness in their eyes was infinitely magnifying.
Ji Huan looked deeply at the man in front of him. His animal body was a black snake, and his body was very perfect.
He has an impeccably handsome face.
Moreover, he is also the president of Pei Group and is as rich as the country.
He was better than Cheng Yongye in every aspect, so she felt it was not a loss.
Suddenly she had an idea.
Since she was going to sleep with him tonight, she could make a condition.
Don't let him sleep in vain.
After Cheng Yongye fell on the sofa, he fell asleep, murmuring from time to time.
Ji Huan glanced at him lightly, then she went to unbutton Pei Xichuan and touched his chest.
She is bold, wild and slutty, very bad, but very seductive.
Pei Xichuan's eyes deepened slightly, and he had no resistance at all to her behavior.
His gaze became fierce, and the evil fire was aroused by her. He just wanted to take her as his own.
Pei Xichuan grabbed her chin with his big hands. He liked this strong method of kissing her the most.
Just when he was about to kiss her lips, Ji Huan blocked his lips with a finger.
"Mr. Pei, I have something to ask you for help."
Pei Xichuan was so tempted that he couldn't restrain himself, but she didn't let him go any further.
He felt like he was being roasted on a fire, so he spoke softly.
"Okay, I promise you everything!"
He didn't even listen to the question and just agreed. At this time, he wanted to do it with her more.
Ji Huan saw that he was so perfunctory.
"Mr. Pei, I am serious, otherwise, I will go back."
After saying that, she was about to get off of him and look like she was about to leave.
Pei Xichuan grabbed her waist with his big hands and held her down, preventing her from leaving.
"Say it!"
A certain man finally got serious.
